subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should OpenClaw add a targeted `/models test-fallback` command, fold this behavior into broader `models status --probe --all` health checks, or reserve it for staged model-migration UX?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear in source, but it introduces a new live provider-call command that overlaps two open model-safety feature requests, so the permanent command surface needs maintainer direction before implementation.

options.title: Add targeted fallback-chain probe
options.body: Implement `/models test-fallback` as a narrow diagnostic that starts from configured fallbacks and reports first or all fallback results.

options.title: Fold into model health checks
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/63145 the canonical configured-model probing surface and close or narrow this request after that contract lands.

options.title: Defer to staged migration UX
options.body: Handle fallback testing only as part of the broader model migration, promotion, and rollback workflow tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/17876.

recommendation.title: Add targeted fallback-chain probe
recommendation.body: Implement `/models test-fallback` as a narrow diagnostic that starts from configured fallbacks and reports first or all fallback results.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined signal from model status/probe history and the prior detailed issue review.
